# Winter Spices

Winter Spices is a minimalist, cozy theme aimed at long-form notes and journaling, set in Georgia and YU Gothic. Its recorded description states that the look stays consistent across light and dark modes while favouring a soft light appearance, and that code readability was improved.

![Winter Spices screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/incantatem2/Obsidian-winter-spices/HEAD/images/winterspices-thumbnail.jpg)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Winter Spices"
    author: "incantatem2"
    repo:   "incantatem2/Obsidian-winter-spices"
    slug:   "winter-spices"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/winter-spices"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/incantatem2/Obsidian-winter-spices"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/incantatem2/Obsidian-winter-spices/HEAD/images/winterspices-thumbnail.jpg"

    modes: ["light"]
    about: "Write long-form notes and journal in a minimalist, cozy interface using Georgia and YU Gothic fonts. Maintain a consistent look across light and dark modes while favoring a soft light appearance and improved code readability."
}
```
